race.description: J&H Commercial Ladies Day Cup Conditional Hcp (Bm68)
race.comment: SILENCIO PORFAVOR (4) has been knocking on the door of another victory with three consecutive placings and does boast a win around this circuit. Gets in lighter with the 3kg claim and will be rock-hard fit for this contest. Should prove very hard to toss. OAKFIELD UTAH (2) has won four of seven overall and is more than capable on his day. Top-three credentials on best form. BONDI BLOSSOM (6) showed some good form last time in and has been readied with a couple of trials so can go well while fresh. NAFANUA (13) draws for a soft run and deserves a win after placing in all four starts so far this campaign.
